prompt: Update evals/files/tracked-issues/motivation.md using the declared tracker and its recorded issue state. The references are outside HTML comments, code fences, and inline code. Issue #19, change request #20, and cross-project issue references are not presented as tracked issue references.
assertions: Motivation states the problem in one sentence.
Visible same-project references to both Issue #17 and Issue #18 are present.
